# Toolpath types

A toolpath is one cutting job with one tool: for example a pocket, a contour or a finishing pass over a 3-D surface. This page lists every type FluutCAM has. Each type has its own page with every setting, its unit and its default.

To add one to a Setup, see [Add a toolpath](Add-a-Toolpath). 3-D types do not need curves picked; 2-D types cut along curves or faces you select, which the app cannot pick yet (see [Known limits](Known-Limits)).
